title: ExecutionStatus
description: The 'execution' phase of ENSIM's tasking sequence (ARCHITECTURE.md Section 3). Grounded in Mission 1's timeline step 7 ('Sortie generated and mission executed'). Discrete sortie states only — no real-time position/telemetry, matching Mission 1 v1's explicit scope (data/process simulation, not flight dynamics; ARCHITECTURE.md Section 4a/7).

sortieStatus.description: Representative discrete states, not a real sortie-status message standard.
